document.title: Weidmüller Heavy Duty Connectors – RockStar (HE series) catalogue; Housing selection RockStar IP65, Size 4

modelingNotes: Exact Weidmüller order 1665240000 is the size 4 HDC 10B DMDQ 2QB cover for hoods, per catalog B.23. Do not substitute the N variant 2559740000 or base cover 1665230000.
Mechanical closure with zero electrical terminals and functions. No electrical path is inferred through the cover, its attachment or metalwork.
IP65 is conditional on the specified closed or mated housing assembly, including seals. No standalone ingress or electrical rating is assigned.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical protective cover with no electrical contacts. Mating and sealing are mechanical assembly conditions.
